title: Global derived Hom adjunction
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image] have its right adjoint a, whose existence is supplied by [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. For P\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), there is a natural isomorphism of global derived Hom complexes $$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(P,a(K))\cong R\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_*P,K)$$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom].
